hyps.why: A parameter-free smoothed branch complements sharp conv features arriving at node 2.
A pooled branch summed with a parallel conv branch adds smoothed complementary information.
After upstream pooling, a learnable 3x3 on 1->2 restores discriminative features.
A downstream 3x3 on 2->3 makes the extra receptive field from 1->2 redundant.
Consecutive pooling on 1->2 and 2->3 compounds blurring and loses detail.
A strong direct conv makes 1->3 redundant, so removing it costs little.
A skip adds little when a strong conv already feeds the output from node 1.
A strong conv on 2->3 makes node 2 an important feature carrier, so cutting its 1->2 input hurts more.
Stacking 3x3 along 0->1->3 builds a complementary larger receptive field.
Chained 1x1 convs add depth but no spatial mixing, so the second one is redundant.
